mu_name_from: OpenMU VersionSeasonSix's CreateGloves (openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/VersionSeasonSix/Items/Armors.cs:268); the model is Player/HDK_GloveMale05.bmd, which MuMain's OpenItems loads for it (MuMain/src/source/Engine/Object/ZzzOpenData.cpp:222). Ours is GloveMale34 by the index-plus-one rule (MU's number 33).

stats.call_note: CreateGloves(number, name, dropLevel, defense, attackSpeed, durability, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel), openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Items/ArmorInitializerBase.cs:234.

why_this_one: The Dark Lord's Sunlight set (docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md batch 6; OpenMU's rows, drop 110-147, lords only). The user, 2026-10-25: 'we need missing Dark lord items', 'make missing peices'. Level 380 (MuMain's item.bmd; the user picked it for Paewang), so Kanturu gear through sim::kanturuGear.
sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names, lower-cased: bright gold plate.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the shading painted on, as the Dark Lord's other sets.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, shallow for the gloss, as the other sets.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_SUNLIGHT_* (no glow, no chrome pass, no sprite; docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md). Its refine colour is PartObjectColor 22, (0.45, 0.45, 0.23) (ZzzObject.cpp:6739-6765, 6788-6818; src/game/shine.cpp); its full set the generic aura (fx/set_shine). MU also lays a +10/+11 boots aura on the 380 sets (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11004-11030), which fx/set_shine has for none of them yet.
